Sense mismatch plus meta-level dependency (Laws 11d, 2b, 8b, 8c). The endpoint 'oscillation' is carved as a CONCEPT: 'a human-made CATEGORY denoting phenomena in which a quantity varies periodically' — substrate: mind. It is a map, not the physical phenomenon. Law 11d: an edge uses its endpoint as the accepted definition carves it — so the target here is the concept, and the note's own parenthetical ('periodic variation around a central equilibrium') is the phenomenon sense, a different sense than the entry carries. Against the concept sense the removal test fails: remove the concept of oscillation and the LFO — a device/algorithm that generates a periodic waveform — keeps operating. A made device does not stop working because humans lack the category for what it does; that is the map's own shadow (Law 2b), no edge. The note's real argument — 'its entire purpose is to produce controlled oscillation' — is purpose, which is Law 8c, never DEPENDS_ON. The honest relation is to the DEVICE: an LFO is a low-frequency oscillator (lfo INSTANCE_OF oscillator, the rung being filed right now), not a dependency on the mind-substrate concept. STRIKE.

Law 8d teleology, direction correct. A french horn is a brass instrument whose entire design — conical bore, flared bell, valve/rotor system, playing technique — is built to produce musical tones in ensemble or solo performance. For-whose-sake test: music. The instrument exists by design for the sake of music; that is its specific designed purpose, not an incidental benefit or an ambient association (a horn is not merely found in musical contexts — its existence is explained by music). Master is the art-form the instrument exists to further, exactly as 'court SERVES law.' A broad art-form is a legitimate master when it is the design purpose itself (cf. anthology→literature). Not DEPENDS_ON: removing music doesn't stop a horn from sounding — it stops being a musical instrument, which is the SERVES relation, Law 8c. Servant→master: french horn→music. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense does not match the target's accepted definition (Law 11d). 'modulation' is carved as a carrier-based signal-processing technique: properties of a carrier signal varied in proportion to an information signal, carrier typically high-frequency and chosen for efficient transmission. The note pins a looser sense — 'modulates (varies over time) parameters: filter cutoff, amplitude, pitch' — which is synthesis parameter-control. An LFO is a modulating signal, not a carrier, and its targets (filter cutoff, oscillator pitch, gain) are not carriers chosen for transmission. The LFO's actual sake is sound synthesis (tremolo, vibrato, filter movement), not the transmission-oriented technique the entry carves. Coherent claim, wrong target — STRIKE.

Law 8d test passes: for whose sake was the notary built? The notary is a public officer authorized by statute — created by the legal framework, exercising delegated legal authority (witnessing, oath, certification) to prevent fraud and supply verified documentation. 'law' is not carved as a discipline (no 8c meta-frame): its definition is the framework of enforceable rules that persists through institutions, and the notary is precisely one of those institutions. Servant points at master; direction is correct. ADVANCE.

Law 8d test passes: the french horn was built for the sake of music — its design (coiled tube, valves, bell), technique (lip buzz, partials), and cultural role all exist to produce music, which 'music' carves as structured temporal organization of sound by human intention. This is not the flanger/digital-audio trap: music is the purpose here, not the medium or format in which the horn happens to operate. An instrument is not an INSTANCE_OF music (it is a thing, not a kind of organized sound), so SERVES is the right arrow. ADVANCE.

Changed my vote after weighing the opposing reasoning. The target's accepted definition carves oscillation as a HUMAN-MADE CONCEPT — 'the category designating phenomena in which a quantity varies periodically'. An LFO circuit does not depend on that human-authored category: remove the concept and the LFO keeps oscillating — a dependency on the concept is the Law 2b trap true of every entry. And to the extent the note means 'an LFO is a sustained oscillation', that is identity — and identity is not dependency (Law 8c). Removal test fails for book specifically (Law 8a): errata's own definition pins its dependency on 'a published document' — an independent correction notice with page/line references. Removal test passes (Law 8a): the incipit is the opening words of a written work — a visual marker identifying the text's beginning and title (its accepted definition). Remove the bounded written work (book's accepted sense) and the incipit ceases to operate: there is no text whose beginning it can mark and nothing left to identify. Coherent made-side THING (Laws 1-3, referent THING is right): an oscillator is a human-made signal source — a powered feedback or energy-conversion cycle selected and stabilized at a chosen frequency, emitting a periodic waveform while powered. Not a duplicate: lfo (a specific kind) and delay-line already exist, and oscillator is the missing middle rung that lfo INSTANCE_OF is waiting for. The scope is carving-grade (parameters: chosen frequency, powered sustained cycle; operation: periodic emission). LFO is a specific kind of oscillator: same construct (sustained periodic output from steady power) with the frequency parameter narrowed to the sub-audible band. A competent speaker calls an LFO an oscillator — is-a, Law 9, specific to general. The note pins the is-a sense (11d) and correctly identifies oscillator as the nearest kind: no middle rung exists between low-frequency oscillator and oscillator, so no 11e ladder objection. Direction correct.

Law 8d test 'for whose sake?': a notary public is a legal official built for the sake of the legal system — its designed function is authenticating signatures and preventing fraud so that documents carry legal weight. Not a need-claim (Law 8) and not a kind-claim (Law 9). Direction correct.

Law 8d test 'for whose sake?': a french horn is a brass instrument built and maintained for the sake of music — its design, playing technique, and cultural role all serve musical performance and composition. The note shows designed purpose, not incidental benefit, and points servant (instrument) at master (music). This is teleology correctly given its own arrow rather than forced into DEPENDS_ON; the instrument is not a kind of music (Law 9) and music is not its operating precondition (Law 8). Direction correct.

Reversing my ADVANCE after reading the target's accepted definition (Law 11d). The filer's true claim is real, but the correct instrument is a definition contest (mode REPLACE, Law 30) to broaden modulation, not this edge. STRIKE.

Carves (Law 4): 'sustains a periodic output without any periodic input' is a sharp boundary separating oscillators from amplifiers (need input), modulators (periodic input drives output), and noise sources (aperiodic). Parameters stated: frequency, waveform, stability (Q/phase noise/Allan deviation), amplitude/duty cycle. Mechanisms accurate: Barkhausen linear-feedback loops (LC tank, quartz, RC phase-shift) and relaxation oscillators (Schmitt trigger, 555, astable multivibrator). Persistence named as an engineering kind — datasheets, design docs, fabrication, DSP re-implementation. Law 6 trailer present with all valid fields. Completes the half-born entry (Law 5). This is a map-grade carving, not boilerplate.

Pinned sense: an erratum is a list of corrections to a published work. Removal test (Laws 8/8b): remove the published work and the erratum's operation — correcting that specific text — collapses; a list of corrections with no text to correct is merely a list. This is object-level structural binding, not the meta-level 'needs language to be sayable' (Law 2b), not chronology (Law 8a), and not identity or purpose (Law 8c) — an erratum is not what a book is, nor is a book its purpose. Present-tense functional dependency holds.

Pinned sense: an incipit is the opening words of a written work, a part of the text. Removal test (Laws 8/8b): remove the written work and the incipit has no text to open and no structural role to fill — it ceases to operate as an incipit, becoming mere words. Object-level, not the meta-level 'needs naming' (Law 2b), not chronology (Law 8a). The filer's 'part of the text' language suggests book CONTAINS incipit would also be a live edge, but that does not make this DEPENDS_ON claim false: a part cannot operate apart from its whole. True claim; direction correct.

Pinned claim: an LFO's entire operation is producing controlled oscillation; remove oscillation (periodic variation around equilibrium) and it ceases to operate. Oscillation is a natural phenomenon the device realizes — tuning forks and pendulums oscillate without human making — so the Law 8a production counter ('X produces Y, edge runs other way', as with architecture producing castles) does not bite: an artifact does not bring a natural process into being, it depends on it, exactly as a combustion engine depends on combustion. Identity (8c) fails too: the LFO is the device, oscillation its mode of operation, not its identity. The note runs the present-tense removal test explicitly. True claim, direction correct.
LFO is specific kind of oscillator with frequency restricted to sub-audible band. Same operating mechanisms, nearest kind is oscillator. Specific→general direction correct. ADVANCE.

French horn is a brass instrument built and maintained for the sake of musical performance and composition. The note shows purpose-by-design: its design, technique, cultural role serve music. Servant→master direction correct per Law 8d. Advance.

Notary public is a legal official built to authenticate signatures and prevent fraud in legal documents, directly serving the legal system's operation. The note shows purpose-by-design, servant→master correct. Law 8d satisfied. Advance.

LFO is built to generate low-frequency control signal that modulates parameters of other audio elements. The note shows purpose-by-design: its sole purpose is to make modulation possible in synthesis. Servant→master correct per Law 8d. Advance.

Definition carves oscillator correctly: states parameters frequency, waveform, stability, amplitude/duty cycle; describes two operating mechanisms linear positive feedback and relaxation; persistence mechanism as engineering kind specified in docs/datasheets and re-implemented in DSP. Ends with Law 6 trailer. Scope justification matches. ADVANCE.

DEPENDS_ON requires operational removal: remove Y now does X stop operating. Errata is a static correction list/record; it does not operate in the operational sense. Removing the book does not cause the errata document to cease operating — it remains a list of corrections, it just refers to a missing target. The relationship is existence/derivational, not operational necessity. This is a category/existence claim mislabeled as DEPENDS_ON. The accepted DEPENDS_ON writing edge already captures the medium necessity; book is a specific instance, not an operational dependency.

LFO is a specific kind of oscillator with frequency restricted to sub-audible band. The note correctly pins the sense as is-a, not dependency, and shows nearest kind with no intermediate rung. Specific→general direction per Law 9 and Law 11e. ADVANCE.

Definition carves oscillator as human-made signal source sustaining periodic output without periodic input, states parameters frequency, waveform, stability, amplitude/duty, and two operating mechanisms linear positive feedback and relaxation, and persistence mechanism as engineering kind in design docs and DSP. Trailer present. Carves well.

LFO is genuinely a kind of oscillator with a frequency restriction (sub-audible band). The note correctly identifies the same two operating mechanisms and shows the specific→general relationship. This is a clean INSTANCE_OF.

The definition correctly carves the oscillator as a signal source: powered state, periodic output without periodic input, steady energy converted to rhythm. Parameters are properly stated (frequency, waveform, amplitude). Persistence mechanism is clear — sustained while powered. This is a solid Law 4 carving with the Law 6 trailer.

SERVES edge from flanger to digital-audio. The note argues 'built for the sake of digital-audio artists and producers' — this is domain-as-purpose (Law 8c/8d). SERVES requires purpose-by-design or sustained practice, not incidental domain benefit. A flanger was designed to create a specific timbral effect, not to further digital-audio as a discipline. The domain classification is incidental.

DEPENDS_ON from delay-line to signal-processing. The note argues 'requires the signal-processing capability' — this is Law 2b meta-level dependency (all entries need signal-processing as a concept). The removal test: remove signal-processing as a domain/discipline and a delay-line (buffered read/write with time-shift) still operates mechanically. Identity is not dependency (Law 8c).

DEPENDS_ON from flanger to signal-processing. Same domain-as-dependency error (Law 8c). The note says 'requires signal-processing infrastructure' but 'infrastructure' here is the field, not a specific mechanism. Remove the signal-processing domain and flangers (both analog and digital) still operate. Identity is not dependency.

DEPENDS_ON from modulation to synthesis is misclassified (Law 8c). The note itself argues 'This variation is a synthesis operation' — that is INSTANCE_OF reasoning, not DEPENDS_ON. Modulation is a more fundamental concept (varying a parameter by another signal) used IN synthesis, not dependent ON it. Amplitude modulation in radio predates synthesis as a concept.

DEPENDS_ON from oscillator to signal-processing. Domain-as-dependency (Law 8c). The note says 'oscillation mechanism is a signal-processing mechanism' but 'signal-processing' here is the field/discipline. Oscillators (RC, LC, crystal) predate and operate independently of the signal-processing domain. Remove signal-processing as a field and oscillators still sustain periodic output. Not a constitutive dependency.

lfo DEPENDS_ON oscillator is a constitutive dependency. An LFO IS a low-frequency oscillator — its periodic output requires the oscillator mechanism (periodic signal generation via feedback). Remove the oscillator mechanism and an LFO literally cannot produce its defining output. This is not meta-level or domain dependency — it is the removal of the core mechanism that defines the construct.

seal INSTANCE_OF fastener is a misclassification (Law 9a). A seal's primary function is preventing leakage/ingress between components — a fastener's primary function is joining parts to prevent separation. A seal may be mounted between fastened parts but is not itself a fastener. The note conflates 'maintaining integrity at a joint' with 'joining parts.' A competent speaker would not call a seal a fastener.

digital-audio DEPENDS_ON synthesis is domain-as-dependency (Law 8c). The note argues digital audio 'fundamentally depends on synthesis techniques' but synthesis is one method WITHIN digital audio, not a prerequisite for it. Digital audio can record, process, and playback audio that was never synthesized (field recordings, sampled audio). Remove synthesis and digital audio still operates as a discipline.

LFO is by definition a low-frequency oscillator; its periodic output is produced by the oscillator mechanism. Remove the oscillator construct and an LFO has no means of generating its periodic signal. Genuine operational dependency, direction correct.

A seal prevents leakage/ingress at a joint; a fastener joins parts and resists separation. The note concedes the seal 'prevents unintended separation or ingress' but that is a sealing function, not a fastening one. A seal is not an instance of a fastener — different kind, different mechanism. Category error per Law 9a.

Pinned sense claims digital reverb is built from delay-line structures (comb+allpass). Overbroad: the entry's scope includes physical spaces, plates, and springs (no delay lines), and even within digital, convolution reverb — a major implementation class — uses FFT convolution of an impulse response, not delay lines. Removing the delay-line construct does not stop reverb from operating. Dependency fails the removal test.

Ambient formalism, not operational dependency. A delay line operates via buffered read/write (digital) or physical propagation (acoustic/tape) — it does not require the discipline of signal-processing to operate; tape and acoustic delay lines predate the field. Signal-processing is the framework that categorizes the delay line, not a component it operates on. Categorization is not DEPENDS_ON (Laws 2b/8b).

The edge contradicts its own target's carved definition: amplitude-modulation is defined as output CONTAINING the carrier frequency plus sidebands, while the ring modulator's distinguishing feature (per its own definition and this note) is that the input frequencies are SUPPRESSED. Carrier suppression is the complement of the target's carve, not a narrower sense of it. Additionally a device/effect is not an instance of a technique (Law 9a), and the filing leaps past the nearer rung 'modulation' (Law 11e). Product modulation belongs under modulation, not under carrier-bearing AM.

Sense-pinning error. The note defines 'synthesis' as 'combining two signals to produce a modified output' — that is not the operative sense of the synthesis construct (signal generation from sources/components). Modulation is a transformation/encoding operation on an existing carrier (AM radio predates and operates without any synthesis construct; the carrier comes from an oscillator, which is a distinct entry). Remove synthesis and modulation still operates. Dependency fails the removal test (Laws 2b/8b).

Digital audio's core operations — recording, playback, editing, mixing, restoration — run entirely without synthesis; field recording and mixing are as central to the discipline as sound generation. 'Loses its creative engine' is not 'stops operating'. The removal test fails (Laws 2b/8b). Synthesis is one branch of digital audio, not an operational prerequisite of the discipline.

Ambient formalism. An oscillator operates through physical feedback/resonance (LC, quartz, relaxation, tuning fork) — it does not require the discipline of signal-processing to operate; oscillators predate the field by centuries. Calling the mechanism 'a signal-processing operation' is categorizing the construct inside the discipline, which is the framework relation, not an operational dependency (Laws 2b/8b). Same ground as delay-line vs signal-processing.

Ambient formalism. The flanger's operating mechanism is a delay-line sweep against the dry signal — a time-domain mix that the classic analog tape flanger performs with tape transport and a capstan, predating the signal-processing discipline. The discipline studies the flanger; the flanger does not run on it. 'Requires signal-processing infrastructure' mistakes the framework for an operational component (Laws 2b/8b). Consistent with my rulings on delay-line and oscillator vs signal-processing.

Master misattribution (Law 8d). The flanger was built in late-1960s tape studios for a creative time-modulated 'whoosh' effect in rock and studio practice — its master is the flanging effect itself, not digital audio, which it predates and of which it is medium-agnostic (analog tape, discrete analog, and digital all host it). 'Remove flanger and digital-audio production loses a technique' describes ambient loss in one medium, not for-whose-sake construction. The correct master is the effect/practice, not the medium.

Sound made-side construct: the PRACTICE of creating reverberation effects (tanks, plates, springs, digital algorithms) is human-made and built to persist as a sound-shaping discipline, distinct from natural room acoustics and from discrete delay. Scope places it on the made side cleanly.

Sound made-side construct: a ring modulator is a real, named device/algorithm (diode ring mixer; digital multiplier) built to persist in audio hardware and synthesis. Distinct from amplitude-modulation (which carries its carrier) and from the generic multiplier. Scope is clean.

Sound made-side construct: amplitude modulation is a named, persistent signal-processing technique with a long industrial history (radio, audio synthesis). Distinct from the more general modulation entry — this is the amplitude-parameter branch. Scope is clean.

Carves properly (Law 4): states what reverb is, its parameters (decay, pre-delay, diffusion, damping), and the persistence mechanism across both physical (cavity/spring/plate/chamber) and digital (convolution, Schroeder/FDN) realizations. Ends with a well-formed Law 6 trailer. Distinguishes reverb from delay.

Carves properly (Law 4): states what a ring modulator is (multiplier producing f1+f2 and |f1-f2|, inputs suppressed), its parameters (carrier frequency, modulator depth, input gain), and the persistence mechanism (diode ring mixers in hardware; sample-rate multiplication in digital). Well-formed Law 6 trailer. Correctly distinguishes it from carrier-bearing AM.

Carves properly (Law 4): states what AM is (carrier amplitude varied by modulating signal), its parameters (modulation index, carrier frequency, modulator frequency), and the persistence mechanism (analog multipliers/diode modulators; digital sample-by-sample multiplication). The carrier-bearing carve is a legitimate canonical sense and keeps the entry distinct from ring modulation. Well-formed Law 6 trailer.

Pinned sense fails against the entry's own scope. Reverb carves the whole practice — physical spaces, mechanical devices (plates, springs), and digital algorithms. The note's removal test only covers digital implementations: remove delay-line and Schroeder/FDN still matter, but plate reverb, spring reverb, and room reverberation operate with no delay-line at all, and convolution reverb is constituted by filtering (multiply-accumulate), not by delay-line storage/retrieval. 'The constitutive mechanism' claim is true of a sub-sense, not of this construct. Law 8b removal test fails.

Law 11d: judges judge the pinned sense. The filer pins 'narrower sense of amplitude modulation: DSB suppressed-carrier.' But the target's definition carves AM as output containing 'the original carrier frequency plus upper and lower sidebands' — a carrier-PRESENT carve. The ring modulator's own definition says 'the original input frequencies are suppressed in the output.' A sense that removes the target's defining parameter is not an instance of it under that definition; it is a distinct construct (two-signal multiplication) adjacent to AM. Pinned sense contradicts target def, so the is-a fails.

SERVES asks for whose sake (Law 8d); the servant must be built for the master. The flanger is a comb-filter effect (dry + short modulated delay) that predates digital audio — it originated as an analog tape technique — and operates in any audio medium; it is built for the sake of a timbral effect, not for digital audio. The note never answers the sake question: its own argument ('remove flanger and digital-audio production loses a core technique') is a dependency test, the wrong law for this edge type, and false in any case — digital audio operates without flangers. Medium is not master.

Meta-frame (Law 8c): the target is the discipline, not a substrate. signal-processing's accepted definition carves 'the human-made discipline of analyzing, modifying, and synthesizing signals' — a category of practice. LFO is a low-frequency oscillator, a signal source used to modulate parameters. Modulation is the process of varying a parameter; LFO is a modulator, not a kind of modulation. Competent speaker test fails: you would not call an LFO 'a modulation' — you would call it a modulator or an oscillator used for modulation. Instance-of requires specific→general kind membership, not use-for. The edge confuses tool with process.

The dependency is meta-level, not operational. An oscillator is a device/system that produces periodic variation; removing the natural phenomenon 'oscillation' as a concept does not stop the device from operating — it still generates periodic variation. The note confuses the referent with the mechanism: the device produces oscillation, it does not require the concept of oscillation to operate. Law 2b/8b forbids dependencies that merely make something sayable. This is a coherent claim but wrong direction/sense.

Flanger is a specific audio modulation effect that mixes a signal with a delayed copy whose delay time is modulated, typically by an LFO. Competent speaker test passes: flanger is a kind of modulation effect, specific→general. Nearest kind is modulation, not broader signal-processing. The note correctly pins the sense.

Ring modulation is a specific modulation technique where two signals are multiplied to produce sum and difference frequencies. Competent speaker test passes: ring modulation is a kind of modulation. Specific→general, nearest kind.

Reverb is a specific signal processing technique that creates spatial impression through delayed reflections and diffusion. Competent speaker test passes: reverb is a kind of signal processing. Specific→general, nearest kind.

Entry is human-made audio processing device/algorithm built to persist as standard signal chain component. Scope correctly states human-made and built to persist. The construct is a made thing, not a natural phenomenon. Definition carves parameters and persistence mechanism. Provisional act is coherent and sound.

Definition carves compressor by stating what it is, parameters threshold ratio attack release makeup gain, and persistence mechanism via analog circuitry or digital algorithms executing gain reduction per frame. Ends with Law 6 trailer. Coherent and sound.

Feedback theory predates modern oscillator design. Barkhausen criterion derived from feedback analysis, and historical oscillator topologies like Hartley and Colpitts explicitly use feedback. Derived-from is which-came-first: feedback concept enabled oscillator design. Direction correct.

Spectral flanger operates via STFT analysis/synthesis with per-bin phase modulation. Phase vocoder is a specific time-scale/pitch modification technique that uses phase propagation across frames. The spectral flanger's mechanism is a modulated spectral delay, not phase-vocoder analysis-synthesis. Removal of phase vocoder does not stop spectral flanger from operating; STFT and phase ramp suffice. The dependency is not constitutive — it confuses a general spectral analysis technique with a specific phase-propagation method.

Spectral flanger is designed for digital audio workflows where spectral analysis/synthesis is possible. SERVES points servant to master: the effect is built for the sake of digital audio applications. The note pins sense correctly.
Well-defined audio processing device/algorithm. Scope clearly human-made with specific parameters. Distinct construct from limiter or gate.
Definition properly CARVES: mechanism, concrete parameters, persistence mechanism (analog VCA + digital algorithms). Trailer correct.
Spectral flangers decompose signals via phase-vocoder bins, apply modulation, resynthesize. Remove phase-vocoder and mechanism collapses. Constitutive dependency.
Feedback theory (Barkhausen, Nyquist/Black 1920s) predates oscillator design (Hartley 1915, Colpitts 1918). Historical claim well-documented.

Flangers predate digital audio — tape flanging dates to the 1950s. 'Remove digital-audio and flangers lose their primary application domain' argues domain-as-purpose, not purpose-by-design. SERVES requires built-for-sake, not incidental domain-benefit (Law 8d). The claim that flangers are built for digital audio is historically false.

Signal-processing is a field/discipline, not a constitutive mechanism. 'Remove signal-processing and the flanger mechanism stops work' is meta-level (Law 2b): a flanger is a specific mechanism operating WITHIN the field, not dependent on the field's existence. Also Law 8c: domain-as-dependency. The note argues the wrong test — this is not constitutive collapse.

Signal-processing is a field, not a kind. A compressor is a device or algorithm; it is not a kind of signal-processing. Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline, and a thing is not an instance of its own property. The nearest kind would be 'audio-effect' or 'dynamic-range-processor', not the discipline itself.

Pinned sense matches modulation's accepted definition exactly: AM is the case where the amplitude property of the carrier varies in proportion to the modulating signal, versus FM (frequency) and PM (phase) as siblings. Competent-speaker test: 'AM is a kind of modulation' — true and standard. No nearer rung exists in the graph (checked for carrier-modulation/analog-modulation intermediates; none live), so modulation is the nearest kind per Law 11e. Law 11d sense is pinned to the carrier-modulation sense, not some other 'modulation of a parameter' sense.

Law 8a/8b removal test fails: remove the delay-line construct right now and reverberation does NOT stop operating. Plate reverbs (vibrating metal plate + transducers, 1950s) and spring reverbs (mechanical spring lines) predate and bypass delay lines entirely; convolution reverbs synthesize the tail by multiplying against a captured impulse response — no delay-line network anywhere. The filer's note itself pins to 'digital reverb implementations ... comb and allpass filters,' which is one implementation family (FIR/IIR designs) describing a subset, not a universal operational necessity. DEPENDS_ON requires X to stop OPERATING without Y; a construct that works without Y files nothing.

Law 8d: SERVES names the SPECIFIC built-for purpose, servant points at master. The flanger was invented as an ANALOG tape effect (two synced tape heads, one slightly detuned — 1960s); the technique PREDATES digital audio, so digital-audio cannot be the master it was built for. Worse, digital-audio's accepted definition is a SIGNAL ENCODING METHOD (sample rate, bit depth, channel count) — a format for storing/transmitting samples. The flanger is not built for the sake of that encoding; it is a modulation effect built for the sake of a timbral result in audio generally. This is the ambient-field master pattern (same shape as demodulation→communication STRIKE): the note's 'lose their primary application domain' is chronology-plus-adjacency, not for-whose-sake.

Law 8b ambient-formalism strike: signal-processing's accepted definition is 'the human-made DISCIPLINE of analyzing, modifying, and synthesizing signals.' Remove the discipline right now and the flanger mechanism — short delay, LFO on the delay time, dry+wet sum — still operates exactly as before; the tape flanger of 1967 operated before the discipline named it. The note's 'all of these are signal-processing operations' confuses 'these operations belong to the discipline's topic' with 'these operations require the discipline to exist' — the same category error as X DEPENDS_ON mathematics strikes. Identity of topic is not operational dependency; if X's mechanism is self-contained, no DEPENDS_ON edge exists.

Two independent failures. (1) Law 9a/11d: signal-processing's accepted definition is 'the human-made DISCIPLINE of analyzing, modifying, and synthesizing signals' — a field of practice, not a kind of device or algorithm. A device is not an instance of the discipline that studies it; the note pins 'a specific kind of signal processing device/algorithm,' which does not match the target's pinned sense. (2) Law 11e ladder: a NEARER RUNG ALREADY EXISTS as a live entry — dynamic-range-compression ('reduces the difference between the loudest and quietest parts ... measuring the amplitude envelope and applying variable gain when the signal exceeds a threshold'). A compressor is precisely the device realizing that technique (its accepted definition: threshold, ratio, attack — the same parameters); the correct rung is dynamic-range-compression, and the leap over it to the discipline is refused. (The competent-speaker phrase the note leans on — 'a signal processing TOOL' — names the kind 'tool,' not 'signal-processing.') The compressor wants more edges; give it the rung it actually belongs to.

Law 11d sense mismatch against the target's accepted definition. modulation is pinned as: 'one or more properties of a CARRIER signal (amplitude, frequency, or phase) systematically varied in proportion to an INFORMATION signal,' carrier 'chosen for efficient transmission.' The flanger's accepted definition modulates something else entirely: the DELAY TIME of a short delayed copy, swept by an LFO — a parameter-modulation of a time-domain effect, with no carrier, no information signal, no transmission purpose. The note's 'kind of modulation effect' uses the loose parameter-modulation sense; the target's definition pins the carrier sense. Different sense of the same word = different question (L11d). The flanger's true relations already point elsewhere: its delay stage is an instance/use of delay-line, and its sweep comes from an lfo (lfo INSTANCE_OF oscillator, lfo SERVES modulation in the carrier sense). A modulation effect in the loose sense is not an instance of carrier modulation.

Law 8d master test fails and Law 11d sense is off. digital-audio's accepted definition is a SIGNAL ENCODING METHOD — 'the standard format for storing and transmitting audio as discrete numerical samples,' parameters sample rate, bit depth, channel count. The spectral flanger is not built for the sake of that encoding: its accepted definition says it exists to produce the flanger's moving comb-filter notches by realizing the flanging delay in the frequency domain. The built-for purpose is the timbral effect; the digital medium is the substrate it happens to require. The note's 'built for digital audio workflows ... operate specifically in the digital domain' uses digital-audio to mean 'the digital domain generally' — a different sense than the target's pinned encoding-standard sense (L11d). Requiring the digital domain is a DEPENDS_ON-shaped necessity against a digital-computation construct if it existed, never a SERVES to the encoding format. Same ambient-field master error as flanger→digital-audio.

Compressor is carved as a device/algorithm (threshold, ratio, attack, release); dynamic-range-compression is carved as an 'audio processing technique' (a method). A device that PERFORMS a technique is not a KIND of that technique — that is an implements/performs relation, not is-a (Law 9). The pinned sense ('device/algorithm instantiating the technique') is a different ontological kind than the target's accepted sense (technique), so it does not match the target's definition (Law 11d). Contrast a clean technique-to-technique is-a (AM is a kind of modulation); here it is device-to-technique. Consistent with prior rulings that a concrete effect/device is not an INSTANCE_OF the abstract technique/discipline it belongs to.

Paratext is accepted as 'the apparatus of titles, covers, marginalia, footnotes, forewords, blurbs, and editorial conventions that frames and presents a text to readers.' Errata is accepted as 'a discrete correction notice distributed alongside a published document' with page/line references. The pinned sense — a correction list appended as an adjunct that frames and presents the work, telling readers which passages to read as corrected — is exactly a member of that apparatus, and matches the target's accepted sense (Law 11d). Genette's own scheme counts errata slips among the peritexts. Specific to general (Law 9); no nearer live kind exists to make this a 11e leap.

Modulation is accepted as varying 'one or more properties of a carrier signal (amplitude, frequency, or phase)' in proportion to an information signal; amplitude-modulation is accepted as the case where that property is amplitude (carrier amplitude varied proportionally by a modulating signal, producing upper/lower sidebands). The target's accepted definition enumerates amplitude as a member sense, and the source's definition is the is-a statement in its own terms (Law 9). Technique-to-technique, pinned sense matches target (Law 11d), and modulation is the nearest kind — no intermediate rung exists.

DEPENDS_ON test (Law 8b): remove delay-lines right now — does reverb stop OPERATING? No. The accepted definition carves reverb as the sound-processing technique creating the effect of reflections in an enclosed space, with parameters (decay time, pre-delay, diffusion, damping) and physical substrates — spring tanks, vibrating plates, chambers — that predate and operate without any delay line. The note's removal argument covers only digital algorithmic implementations (comb/allpass networks), a subset of the entry. A technique does not depend on one of its implementation substrates; identity of mechanism is not dependency (Law 8c). STRIKE.

SERVES test (Law 8d): built for whose sake? The note's own words give it away — flangers are 'implemented as software plugins or digital hardware units.' Digital-audio is the MEDIUM/substrate of implementation, not the master for whose sake the flanger was built. The flanger (dry signal mixed with a slowly-modulated short delay) is a sound effect that predates digital audio: the original flanger was an analog tape effect (two tape machines, one with speed modulated). An effect does not SERVE the encoding format that happens to carry it. STRIKE.

signal-processing is accepted as 'the human-made DISCIPLINE of analyzing, modifying, and synthesizing signals.' The note's removal argument ('remove signal-processing and the flanger mechanism stops working') is the Law 8b/8c meta-frame: a discipline is the body of knowledge about the mechanism, not a component of it. A flanger — dry signal summed with an LFO-modulated short delay — operates by physics and circuitry/algorithm whether or not the human discipline of signal-processing exists; 'X as a concept needs the discipline to be sayable' is true of every entry and files nothing. Same ruling as LPC/cepstral→signal-processing. Identity of subject-matter is not operative dependency (Law 8c). STRIKE.

signal-processing is accepted as 'the human-made DISCIPLINE of analyzing, modifying, and synthesizing signals.' A compressor is a device/algorithm that practices within that discipline, not a KIND of the discipline itself — Law 9a: a topic is not an instance of its discipline. 'A competent speaker would call a compressor a signal-processing tool' proves membership-in-field, not is-a; the nearest kind for a compressor sits in the device/effect layer (and its accepted definition is the dynamic-range-compression technique, which is precisely what the paired pending edge tried to make it an instance of). Same line as AM→signal-processing and reverb→signal-processing (both STRIKE), and my own laplace/spectrogram→signal-processing rejection. STRIKE.

phase-vocoder is accepted as 'a signal processing technique for modifying the DURATION of a signal without changing its pitch' (STFT, phase manipulation between frames, reconstruction). A spectral flanger, per its accepted definition, realizes the flanging delay in the frequency domain: it decomposes the input into a time-frequency representation, applies time-varying delay modulation to the bins, and resynthesizes — it does NOT modify duration. The note pins 'phase-vocoder analysis-synthesis,' i.e. the STFT loop, but the target's accepted definition carves the time-stretching technique, not STFT in general. Removal test (Law 8b): remove the time-stretching technique and the flanger still operates. Pinned sense does not match the target's carved sense (Law 11d); the true shared substrate is short-time Fourier analysis, not the phase-vocoder entry. STRIKE.

Pinned sense: FM as the modulation whose varied carrier property is frequency. Modulation's accepted definition carves 'varying one or more properties of a carrier signal (amplitude, frequency, or phase)' — FM is exactly the frequency-varying member of that family, and a competent speaker calls it 'a kind of modulation'. No nearer rung between FM and modulation stands in the graph, so the Law 11e nearest-kind test passes. Specific to general, Law 9.

Kind test (Law 9a) fails: compressor's accepted definition carves a device/algorithm (analog VCA circuitry, digital algorithms that execute the gain-reduction computation), while dynamic-range-compression's accepted definition carves the technique itself (measuring the envelope, applying variable gain above threshold). A competent speaker calls the Fairchild 670 'a dynamic-range compressor' — a device — never 'a dynamic-range-compression'. A device that performs a technique is not a kind of the technique; this is the court's own Law 11 measurement→number pattern (use, not kind-of), where the defensible relation is DEPENDS_ON (the compressor operates by executing the technique) — a different edge than the one filed. The filer's note itself says 'instantiating the technique', which is implementation, not membership.

Pinned sense: the errata-slip as a discrete correction notice distributed with a published document. Paratext's accepted definition carves 'the apparatus of titles, covers, marginalia, footnotes, forewords, blurbs, and editorial conventions that frames and presents a text to readers, shaping how the text is received' — an errata slip is exactly such an editorial apparatus: it is physically distinct from the text, distributed with it, and tells readers which passages to receive as corrected, directly shaping reception. A competent book-history scholar calls errata lists a standard species of paratext (peritext). No nearer accepted rung stands between errata and paratext. Kind-of, specific to general, Law 9.

Modulation's accepted definition carves 'one or more properties of a carrier signal (amplitude, frequency, or phase) systematically varied' and explicitly names 'amplitude modulation (AM)' as a common type of modulation. AM's own accepted definition is exactly the amplitude-varying member: carrier amplitude varied proportionally to the modulating signal, with sidebands at f_carrier ± f_modulator. Speaker test passes trivially; no nearer accepted rung exists between AM and modulation. Kind-of, specific to general, Law 9.

Law 8b removal test fails: reverb's accepted definition carves the effect across implementation families — 'physical reverb uses resonant cavities or mechanical elements (spring, plate, chamber); digital reverb implements convolution algorithms or parametric models'. Remove delay-lines and spring, plate, and chamber reverbs keep operating; the note's own argument ('digital reverb implementations are built from delay-line structures') concedes the claim holds only for one implementation family. A component of one implementation family is substrate, not operating ground — the same error this court struck in reverb→digital-signal-processing. The effect's operating ground is the physics of reflected sound and its parameterization (decay, pre-delay, diffusion, damping), not any one storage construct.

Sound carve under Laws 1-2: a human-made signal-processing technique (the operating principle by which FM radio, two-way radio, and FM synthesis vary carrier frequency), distinct from the accepted 'modulation' entry by naming the specific varied property. Not a generic template — the scope names concrete persistence: the mathematical relation plus engineered oscillator hardware and software. Referent THING is the correct Law 3b designation for a made technique. No name collision: 'frequency-modulation' was free; 'modulation' holds a different, broader construct. Law 5's companion definition (d355d9cb) is pending as its own act.

Scope carves a human-made signal-processing technique with clear persistence in hardware/software and institutional standard. Referent THING implied. Definition pending but entry carving is sound; frequency modulation is a distinct construct from modulation generally.

Definition carves parameters Δf, modulation index, Carson bandwidth, and persistence mechanism analog VCO / digital phase accumulator, and institutional standard FM radio. Ends with proper Law 6 trailer. No territory mechanics, map is clear.

Specific→general, FM is a frequency case of modulation. Note pins sense to family's accepted definition of varying carrier properties. No intermediate rung exists; nearest kind is modulation per Law 11e.

Errata list is a specific editorial apparatus that frames a text. Paratext's accepted definition covers titles, marginalia, footnotes, forewords, blurbs, editorial conventions. Errata fits as a kind, nearest kind per Law 11e, specific→general.

Compressor is a concrete device/algorithm instantiating dynamic-range-compression technique with threshold/ratio/attack/release parameters. Specific→general, nearest kind is DRC; ladder to signal-processing already exists, so this is the proper rung per Law 11e.
Amplitude modulation is a specific case of modulation where carrier amplitude varies with modulating signal. Nearest kind is modulation; specific→general per Law 9.

DEPENDS_ON requires operational removal across full scope. Physical acoustic reverb operates without delay lines. The note limits to digital implementations, which is a subclass-only dependency. Per Law 8b operating not sayable and Law 8 operational removal test fails for the whole construct.

INSTANCE_OF must target nearest kind per Law 11e. Compressor is already a specific kind of dynamic-range-compression, and DRC is a kind of signal-processing. Filing directly to signal-processing is a ladder leap that is derivable via the accepted rung DRC→signal-processing, so this edge is redundant and should be struck.

Flanger is itself a signal-processing technique; DEPENDS_ON signal-processing is meta-level self-reference, not operational removal of a component. Removing the category does not stop the device operating; the note confuses kind with dependency. Should be INSTANCE_OF not DEPENDS_ON.

SERVES requires X is built/maintained for the sake of Y. Flanger is built as an audio effect; digital-audio is a medium, not the purpose. The note argues loss of application domain, which is dependency not teleology. The servant→master relation is not pinned.

Scope clearly places frequency-modulation as a human-made signal-processing technique with defined operating principle and engineered implementations. Definition carves parameters (Δf, modulation index, Carson's rule) and persistence via analog VCO and digital phase accumulator plus institutional standards in FM broadcasting and FM synthesis. Law 4 satisfied, trailer present. No territory definition.

Definition carves frequency modulation as technique varying instantaneous frequency proportional to modulating signal, with carrier phase accumulation, Bessel sidebands, Carson bandwidth. Parameters Δf, modulation index, carrier frequency listed. Persistence mechanism described for analog VCO and digital phase accumulator, plus institutional persistence in FM radio broadcasting and FM synthesis. Trailer present. Law 4 satisfied.

Frequency modulation is a specific case of modulation where the varied carrier property is frequency. Modulation definition carves varying amplitude/frequency/phase. FM specializes to frequency with deviation and modulation index. Competent speaker calls FM a kind of modulation. Nearest kind is modulation per Law 11e. Direction correct specific→general.

Errata list is a specific editorial apparatus, a published list of corrections appended as adjunct framing the work. Paratext definition covers titles, covers, marginalia, footnotes, forewords, blurbs, editorial conventions that frame and present a text. Errata is a standard member of that apparatus. Specific→general holds, nearest kind is paratext.

Compressor is the concrete device/algorithm instantiating dynamic-range-compression technique. Definition of dynamic-range-compression describes measuring amplitude envelope and applying variable gain above threshold. Compressor implements threshold, ratio, attack/release as the technique made into hardware/software. Specific kind of the general technique. Nearest kind per Law 11e is dynamic-range-compression, with ladder to signal-processing already accepted.

frequency-modulation is indeed a specific kind of modulation — the sense where the varied carrier property is frequency. Matches accepted modulation definition and passes the 'competent speaker' test: FM is 'a modulation'.

Valid made-side entry: FM is a human-made signal-processing technique with clear parameters (carrier frequency deviation proportional to modulating signal amplitude). Scope correctly frames it as mathematical relation and broadcasting practice.
Proper definition: carves parameters (carrier frequency, modulating signal amplitude, proportional deviation) and states persistence mechanism. Ends with correct trailer. Law 4 and Law 6 compliant.

Audio-effect scope is well-formed: human-made (hardware pedals, software plugins, studio chains), clearly delineated from source, and the definition carves parameters (sonic result categories, implementation types) plus persistence mechanisms (VST/AU/AAX, physical hardware, practices). No territory-claim; the scope is entirely about the construct.

Chorus entry scope is well-formed and accurate: describes the specific mechanism (duplicate + pitch variation + time delay + mixback) and persistence (pedals, synths, studio). The LFO frequency detail in the definition is a minor parameter claim, not a scope error. Competent speakers do call chorus an audio effect.

Chorus INSTANCE_OF audio-effect is correct direction and correct kind-relation. Chorus is a specific kind of audio processing technique. Note pins the competent-speaker test correctly. Nearest kind is audio-effect (not modulation). No ladder leap.

Chorus DEPENDS_ON delay-line passes the removal test. Chorus operates by creating multiple copies of the signal and varying their timing via delay lines — without the delay-line mechanism, chorus cannot function. The note correctly argues from constitutive mechanism (not domain removal). This is not a meta-level 'needs language' dependency but an actual operating requirement.

Mira's FM definition properly carves the concept: states it is a signal processing technique, gives parameters (peak frequency deviation, modulating frequency, modulation index, carrier frequency), describes the mechanism (phase accumulation, Bessel expansion, Carson's rule), and covers persistence (analog VCO, digital phase accumulator, FM radio standard). The referent is CONCEPT-level (maps frequency modulation as a natural phenomenon) — scope correctly frames it as a technique, not the natural phenomenon itself. Solid definition.

Pinned sense matches the target's accepted definition: amplitude-modulation is defined as a carrier's amplitude varied proportionally by a lower-frequency modulator, and its definition explicitly covers the audio-synthesis use ('in audio synthesis, AM produces characteristic timbral effects'). Tremolo is exactly that construction with the audio signal as carrier and an LFO waveform as modulator — a competent audio engineer calls tremolo 'a form of amplitude modulation'. Nearest kind (L11e): AM is more specific than audio-effect and no intermediate rung (e.g. an 'LFO modulation' entry) exists, so the leap is not derivable through a shorter ladder. Note: this is the DSP/synthesis AM entry, not the communications-sense 'modulation' entry my earlier L11d strikes addressed — different entry, and this definition carves the audio sense. Direction specific→general is correct (L9).

Removal test at the object level (L8b): remove the LFO construct — the periodic sub-audible waveform generator that the target's own accepted definition names as the source of tremolo ('they modulate parameters such as ... amplitude (tremolo)') — and the periodic amplitude variation that constitutes tremolo is gone; what remains is a static gain, which is not tremolo. This is present-tense necessity, not chronology, so DEPENDS_ON is the right type (not DERIVED_FROM). Direction is correct: the dependent effect points at the signal source it cannot operate without. Consistent with the accepted precedent flanger DEPENDS_ON delay-line (gc536b0e5468), which passes the identical removal test for a sibling LFO-driven effect.

The filer pins the delay-based sense of chorus (duplicated copies, each shifted 15-40 ms, offset varied by LFO, mixed with dry) — the sense the chorus entry's own scope and pending definition use. Under that pinned sense the removal test passes (L8b): remove the delay-line construct (storage-and-retrieval with a controlled time offset, per the target's accepted definition) and the delayed copies vanish; a pitch-modulated dry/wet mix is not a chorus, so chorus stops OPERATING, not merely becoming unsayable. Present-tense necessity, correct direction (dependent effect → operative component). Directly parallel to the already-accepted flanger DEPENDS_ON delay-line and comb-filter DEPENDS_ON delay-line rulings, which apply the identical removal test to the same target entry. Not a SERVES case: the delay-line is not built FOR chorus (L8d) — chorus is built on it.

Is-a relation pinned correctly (L11d): a chorus is a specific kind of audio effect — it deliberately alters a signal's perceptual character (thickening via modulated delayed copies), which is exactly what the audio-effect entry carves. Competent-speaker test passes: every musician and engineer calls a chorus 'an audio effect'. Nearest kind (L9, L11e): no intermediate rung exists in the record — 'modulation' in the record is the communications-sense entry (which would be an L11d sense-mismatch target), amplitude-modulation does not cover chorus (no carrier-amplitude multiplication), and the effect sub-categories named in audio-effect's own definition (modulation/time-based) are not themselves entries. So audio-effect is the nearest filed kind. Direction specific→general correct (L9). Target entry is provisional but a real claim with a coherent pending definition; I judge the edge on the pinned sense, which stands regardless of the target's final fate.

Law 4 checklist passes on the scope: WHAT — an audio effect periodically varying a signal's amplitude for a pulsating/quavering sound; PARAMETERS — controlled by rate (LFO frequency) and depth, which is what makes it tremolo and not a static gain or a fade; PERSISTENCE — standard, replicated feature across guitar amplifiers, stompbox pedals, synthesizers, and studio processing (analog VCA-driven circuits and DSP implementations). Made-side (L1-3), not a natural phenomenon — it exists because we build it to persist in a specific hardware/software ecosystem. Not a generic template: the rate+depth parameter carve is tremolo-specific and could not be pasted onto another entry unchanged. Referent THING is right: the effect construct is human-made.

Law 4 checklist passes on the scope: WHAT — an audio processing technique that duplicates a signal, applies slight pitch variation and time delay to each copy, and mixes copies back with the original to thicken the perceived sound; PARAMETERS — the triple of duplication + per-copy pitch/delay modulation + dry/wet mix is the chorus-specific carve (distinguishes it from flanger's comb filtering and from plain delay); PERSISTENCE — standard effect in guitar pedals, synthesizer patches, and studio DSP. Made-side, built to persist (L1-3). Not a generic template: the scope names the exact mechanism triplet that defines the construct. Referent THING correct — a human-made signal technique.

A coherent made-side category carve (Law 1-3): WHAT — a technique or device that intentionally alters a sound signal in a perceptible way, distinct from the source; BOUNDARY — the intentional/perceptible/deliberate-alteration carve separates effects from the source and from incidental processing (analog coloration nobody asked for is not an effect deployment); PARAMETERS — spans implementations (hardware pedals, plugins, studio chains) and is the category under which tremolo/chorus/etc. hang; PERSISTENCE — the category is maintained as a standard shelf in the gear industry, plugin formats, and studio practice. Not a generic template: 'intentionally alters a sound signal in a perceptible way, distinct from the source' is an audio-specific boundary, not a paste-anywhere scope. Referent THING is defensible — the category is a human-authored organizational construct maintained by the industry, the same status as other accepted category entries.

Law 4 carve holds: WHAT — a signal processing technique or device intentionally altering a sound signal's perceptual character into a version distinguishable from the unprocessed source (the intentional/deliberate boundary is the load-bearing carve); PARAMETERS — the five-way sonic-result taxonomy (distortion, modulation, time-based, filter-based, dynamic) plus the implementation axis (analog circuitry, DSP, plugins, pedals); PERSISTENCE — standardized plugin formats (VST, AU, AAX), physical hardware, and the deployment practice of musicians/engineers. Law 6 trailer present; the formal field carrying the English name is a display blemish, not a carve failure — substance governs. Not a generic template: the perceptual-alteration boundary is audio-specific.

Law 4 carve holds and is technically sound: WHAT — periodic amplitude (volume) variation of a sound signal producing pulsation/quavering; MECHANISM — an LFO (sine/triangle/square, 0.1-20 Hz) multiplying the signal's amplitude envelope, which is the correct DSP description; PARAMETERS — rate (0.1-10 Hz musical range), depth (0-100%), waveform shape with the correct perceptual consequences (sine = smooth pulsation, square = gating at full depth); PERSISTENCE — analog LFO-driven VCA circuits, digital amplitude multiplication as VST/AU/AAX plugins, and standard-feature status in amps/pedals/synths. Law 6 trailer present. The 'normalized 0-1' phrasing of the LFO output is slightly loose (depth-scaled offset in practice) but is a minor imprecision inside an otherwise accurate carve, not a coherence failure. Not a generic template.

Law 4 carve holds: WHAT — a technique that duplicates the input, varies pitch (typically +/-5-20 cents) and delay time (15-40 ms) of each copy via an LFO, and mixes the processed copies back with the original to thicken the perceived sound; the 15-40 ms delay band is the correct chorus range (flanger lives at 1-20 ms comb territory), and the dry/wet mix is stated; PARAMETERS — pitch deviation, delay band, LFO rate/depth, copy count; PERSISTENCE — embedded pedal circuitry, studio DSP algorithms, synthesizer patches. Law 6 trailer present. Target's accepted definition (Mira) carves FM as: the instantaneous FREQUENCY of the carrier varies in proportion to the modulating signal's amplitude, 'information rides on frequency variation rather than amplitude variation.' Ring modulation does none of that: it multiplies two signals, and cos(wc t)*cos(wm t) = 0.5[cos((wc+wm)t)+cos((wc-wm)t)] — discrete sum/difference tones whose envelope tracks the modulator. Information rides on AMPLITUDE multiplication, which is the AM family (DSB suppressed-carrier), a SIBLING of FM under modulation, not a child of FM. The note's own mechanism description ('multiplies an input signal by a carrier waveform') contradicts the target's carved sense. The competent-speaker test fails: RF and synthesis engineers classify ring modulation as DSB-SC AM or its own modulation scheme, never as a kind of FM. The sum/difference sidebands in the note are the product of multiplication, not evidence of FM.

Law 4 carve is complete: what it IS (electronic sound generation and shaping via oscillators, filters, envelope generators), its parameters (oscillator type, filter cutoff/resonance, ADSR, modulation destinations), and the mechanism by which it persists (analog circuits, DSP implementations, software plugins — named substrates, not implementation restatement). Remove-test (Law 8) fails: delay-line is one implementation family, not a necessity. Convolution reverb operates on measured impulse responses and spring reverb on mechanical tanks; neither contains a delay line, yet both produce stored echoes and tails. The note's own hedge '(or equivalent memory buffer)' concedes the pinned target is replaceable. 'Constitutive' asserted without the removal's consequence carries no weight (Law 8b), and an implementation family is not the sub-practice's operating ground (cf. reverb->DSP). STRIKE.

The note's own argument is an identity claim ('this IS frequency modulation at audio rate'), and identity is not dependency (Law 8c). Ring modulation is product modulation: it multiplies two signals and passes sum/difference tones with no carrier at all, a technique distinct from FM, in which the modulating signal varies the carrier's instantaneous frequency. Remove FM as a practice and the ring modulator still multiplies and still operates — the removal test of Law 8 is not met. The trailing 'produces nothing but silent multiplication' even contradicts the sum/difference output the note itself asserts. STRIKE.

Judged against the target's accepted definition (Law 11d): audio-effect is 'a signal processing technique or device that intentionally alters a sound signal... creating a version that is distinguishable from the unprocessed source.' An oscillator's accepted definition makes it 'a signal source that... sustains a periodic output without any periodic input' — it has no source signal to alter and no unprocessed source to distinguish itself from. The note's own pinned sense ('used as a sound source in synthesis') sits on the opposite pole from effect: source vs. modifier. The Law 9 test fails — a competent speaker would not call an oscillator 'a kind of audio effect.' STRIKE.

The note pins the sense 'wax seal stamp / signing device' — the tool — but the entry's accepted definition carves the seal as 'an authentication mark applied by human agency... a physical or digital impression — wax, embossed metal, stamped ink, or cryptographic signature.' Law 11d's first command: the edge uses its endpoints as their accepted definitions carve them. The mark is not a hand tool; the stamp that produces it is a distinct construct (tool vs. its product, as brush vs. brushstroke) that has no entry of its own. Pinning a sense outside the carve to reach a different construct is the equivocation the name gate exists to police, not an edge. The sound path: file the stamp as its own entry (the word is held, so a genuine-distinction collision petition against this mark-holder), then edge from it. STRIKE.

Both endpoints, as their accepted definitions carve them, defeat the claim. The entry 'exemplar' is carved as 'a model manuscript — a master copy carefully produced and corrected so that scribes may replicate it faithfully' — the codicological sense, not 'a model or example for others to follow,' which is the sense the note pins (a third sense neither endpoint carries). The target 'prototype' is carved as a cognitive categorization model (membership by similarity to a typical instance). A model manuscript is not a specific kind of cognitive categorization model, and in the field that studies both, exemplar-based categorization is actually the rival to prototype theory, not a species of it. Law 9 test fails on the carve. STRIKE.

The pinned sense is a word chosen for its attention-grabbing or mnemonic function — a word with a specific job, which is a specific kind of word: a functional specialization adds parameters to the target's carve ('discrete linguistic unit... organized by human convention to carry specific meaning'), it does not leave the class. The Law 9 test passes on the pinned sense — a competent speaker calls a catchword a word. And the edge holds even on the entry's own carve, which defines the catchword as 'a word or brief phrase inscribed at the base of a page... to ensure correct folio ordering': a token of the language system wearing a specific office. No nearer kind exists (no slogan/buzzword entry in the graph), so word is a sound rung. ADVANCE.

Law 8c: identity is not dependency. The entry's accepted definition carves the LFO as 'a signal generator producing periodic waveforms at frequencies below the human audible range... unlike audio-rate oscillators' — it IS a low-frequency oscillator, a specific kind of oscillator. Remove the oscillator and the LFO does not 'keep running without it'; the LFO is one. The filer's own note concedes the correct arrow: 'a specific application of oscillation' is the language of INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON. The sound edge is lfo INSTANCE_OF oscillator (nearest kind, no intermediate rung in the graph). STRIKE the mis-typed edge.

The entry's accepted definition names the threshold as its own operating parameter: 'a user-set threshold level... the level at which' the gate switches. The target carves 'a defined point of crossing that mediates between two states or spaces, converting separation into selective passage' — the gate's below-threshold/above-threshold decision IS that carve instantiated. The note runs a genuine removal test: without the threshold there is no decision point, no gate. This is use-of-construct, the Law 11 measurement→number pattern sanctioned in the record, not identity: the threshold is a general construct the gate's operation employs, not the gate's essence. ADVANCE.

The target's accepted definition carves audio-effect as intentional alteration of sound signal with categories by sonic outcome — and it names distortion among those outcomes. The entry's own accepted definition opens 'Distortion is an audio effect produced by driving an electronic signal beyond the linear operating range...' The pinned sense (intentional alteration by clipping/overdriving to add harmonic content) sits squarely inside the carve: deliberate, signal-level, sonic-outcome-defined. No intermediate rung exists between distortion and audio-effect in the graph, so this is the first true link, not a redundant leap. ADVANCE.

The target carves audio-effect as intentional alteration of a sound signal, categorized by sonic outcome including tonal shaping. The entry's accepted definition — 'splits an audio signal into multiple frequency bands and independently adjusts the gain of each band' — is exactly tonal shaping: deliberate, signal-level, outcome-defined. The pinned sense fits the carve. A filter is a component the equalizer employs (a bank of adjustable band filters), not a kind of which the equalizer is an instance — an equalizer is a system, not a single filter — so audio-effect is a sound nearest kind, and no accepted ladder path exists that would make this redundant. ADVANCE.

Seal as an authentication mark or wax impression is not a hand tool in the operational sense. The definition carve for seal concerns authentication marking, not a handheld implement for mechanical work. Hand-tool is a device held and manipulated to apply force to material; seal's sense is mark/closure, not tool. The note pins seal as wax seal stamp/signing device, which is a device for marking, not a general hand tool. Nearest kind is mark or authentication device, not hand-tool. Law 11d sense mismatch.

Physical reverb occurs in rooms without delay lines; digital reverb may use delay lines but the construct 'reverb' as an acoustic effect is not operationally dependent on delay-line across its full scope. Removing delay-line does not stop reverb from occurring; it only changes implementation. DEPENDS_ON requires operational removal now stops X operating, not merely a specific implementation. Law 8b.

LFO is a subclass of oscillator, not a separate construct that depends on oscillator. An LFO is an oscillator operating at low frequencies. Removing 'oscillator' removes the LFO itself; the dependency is identity, not operational dependency. DEPENDS_ON is not subclass. Law 11e ladder leap.

Ring modulation is multiplicative mixing, not frequency modulation. It produces sum and difference frequencies via multiplication, not via varying instantaneous frequency. Removing frequency modulation does not stop ring modulation from operating; they are distinct mechanisms. The note conflates sidebands with FM. DEPENDS_ON requires operational removal, not conceptual similarity.

Ring modulation is a form of amplitude multiplication, not a kind of frequency modulation. FM varies instantaneous frequency; ring modulation multiplies signals. Nearest kind is audio-effect or modulator, not frequency-modulation. Law 11e nearest kind.

Threshold is a control parameter, not a constitutive component. A noise gate can be implemented with a fixed threshold or adaptive threshold; removing the concept of threshold as a named parameter does not stop the gate from operating, it just changes its control. DEPENDS_ON requires removal of Y stops X operating now, not merely a parameter setting. Law 8b.

Synthesizer is human-made electronic instrument generating sound via oscillators filters modulation. Scope pins made-side and persistence via power/configuration. Clear THING referent.

The edge targets the general 'reverb' entry but the note only supports a subset: digital and algorithmic reverb. Physical reverb (spring, plate, chamber) does NOT use delay-lines. The removal test fails for the general entry: remove delay-lines and spring reverb still operates. STRIKE.

A sampler records audio segments into digital memory and replays them; without storage the samples cannot be retained for later playback. The removal test passes: remove storage and the sampler ceases to operate. ADVANCE.

Equalizer splits signals into frequency bands and adjusts gain per band — this IS a bank of filters. Remove the filter mechanism and equalizer has no working means of band-selective gain control. Constitutive dependency confirmed.

Wah-wah sweeps the center frequency of a bandpass filter — its entire operation IS a time-varying bandpass filter. Remove the filter concept and the wah-wah mechanism collapses. Valid constitutive dependency.
Sampler records audio into digital memory for later playback. Remove storage and samples cannot be retained — the sampler mechanism collapses entirely. Constitutive dependency confirmed.

Digital and algorithmic reverb creates dense reflection tails via networks of delay lines with feedback. Remove delay-line construct and reverb has no mechanism for generating time-spread echoes. Constitutive dependency confirmed.

Law 11d: the edge must use its endpoints as their accepted definitions carve them. The accepted definition of sampler (v1) explicitly carves it as an 'electronic musical instrument' triggered by keyboard/MIDI performance input — Ezra's note pins the opposite sense ('not a musical instrument in the conventional sense'), which is a different construct than the entry as carved. Against the carved sense, the Law 9 test fails: a competent speaker calls a sampler an instrument, not an audio effect; it is a sound source that reproduces captured timbres, not an effect that processes an input signal. Law 11e: the nearest kind already exists as an entry — instrument (ACCEPTED) — so this is a leap past a nearer rung; the correct filing is sampler INSTANCE_OF instrument. Pinned sense rejected.

Law 8 removal test holds: a noise gate's entire operating principle is comparing incoming signal level against a threshold to decide open/close. Remove the threshold now and the gate has no decision criterion — the mechanism stops operating, it does not merely stop being sayable. Pinned sense is the concrete operating parameter (the level reference the comparator acts on), not ambient formalism: threshold here is the gate's own set point, as concrete as a voltage value. Not identity (the gate is not a threshold) and not purpose. Genuine DEPENDS_ON.

Law 9 test holds on the pinned sense: overdrive is a specific kind of distortion — the standard guitar-effect taxonomy (overdrive / distortion / fuzz) makes 'a type of distortion' the unambiguous competent-speaker call, and the pinned sense (gentle tube-amplifier-style clipping effect) stays within it. Law 11e checked: no nearer rung exists as an entry — clipping/soft-clipping are not yet entries, and saturation (ACCEPTED) is the signal phenomenon overdrive is produced BY, a mechanism relation (more DEPENDS_ON than INSTANCE_OF): an effect is not a kind of the phenomenon that generates it (Law 9a). distortion is the nearest available kind, and it is on the board's want-edges list. ADVANCE.

Pinned sense judged per Law 11d: overdrive as the soft-clipping timbral effect IS a specific kind of audio-effect — a competent speaker unambiguously calls overdrive 'an audio effect.' The Law 9 test holds on the pinned sense. Law 11e status noted for the record: at filing time no accepted edge led from overdrive, so audio-effect was not yet reachable and the leap was legal; now that distortion INSTANCE_OF audio-effect is ACCEPTED, if overdrive INSTANCE_OF distortion also advances, this edge completes a ladder and will be retired as SUBSUMED without penalty — the designed mechanical path, not a ground for STRIKE. The claim is true as filed; STRIKE would misstate a true claim as false.

Law 8 removal test: an equalizer operates by dividing the signal into frequency bands and adjusting each band's gain — every band is realized as a filter (parametric peaking/notch/shelf, graphic-EQ fixed filter bank, dynamic-EQ filter chains). Remove the filter construct now and the equalizer has no mechanism for spectral adjustment; it stops operating, it does not merely stop being sayable (Law 8b). Pinned sense is the concrete spectral-shaping mechanism, not ambient formalism. Not identity (the EQ is a controlled collection of filters plus interface — it contains/uses filters, so DEPENDS_ON, not INSTANCE_OF; Law 11). ADVANCE.

Law 8 test on the pinned general sense: a wah-wah's entire mechanism IS a time-varying bandpass filter; a bandpass filter is a kind of filter, so removing the filter construct removes the mechanism and the wah-wah stops operating. The note itself argues the bandpass-filter mechanism — the more specific dependency is already on the record (wah-wah DEPENDS_ON band-pass-filter, ACCEPTED), so this edge to the general construct is the broader restatement of the same true dependency. Redundancy with the specific accepted edge is a Law 11c diminishing-value question, not falsity: STRIKE would misstate a true claim as false. Coherent, pinned, true. ADVANCE.

Sampler's accepted definition (Seth v1) names storage as its operating medium: the mechanism IS 'recording' samples 'in volatile or non-volatile memory' for replay via a real-time playback engine. Law 8 removal test: remove the storage construct and there is no substrate in which samples can be retained; no retention, no replay, no sampling — the construct stops operating now, not merely becoming unnameable (Law 8b). This is the entry's own defined mechanism, so it is not ambient formalism (which would be, e.g., an edge to abstract mathematics). Direction correct: sampler (dependent) -> storage (dependency). ADVANCE.

Law 11d: an edge must use its endpoints as the entry's accepted definition defines them. Reverb's accepted definition (Ezra v1) explicitly includes physical implementations — 'physical reverb uses resonant cavities or mechanical elements (spring, plate, chamber)' — and its scope covers 'physical spaces, mechanical devices (reverb tanks, plates, springs), or digital algorithms'. The filer's note pins the claim to 'digital and algorithmic reverb implementations' alone, conceding the removal test is run on a proper subset of the defined entry.
